programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond
programme.desc: A boy genius in the 1960s finds his way into a spectacular futuristic metropolis while attempting to promote his idea for a jetpack. Decades later, he has grown into a disillusioned adult, while a girl who has the talent and enthusiasm he has lost also finds her way into this strange new world, and together they attempt to uncover its secrets. Fantasy adventure inspired by the theme park, starring George Clooney, Britt Robertson and Hugh Laurie.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

programme.title: The Beach
programme.desc: A backpacker arrives in Bangkok, where a wild-eyed veteran traveller tells him the location of a remote paradise island. When he finally makes it to the golden beaches, he discovers there is already a community in residence. All is not as it seems, however, and the blissful idyll soon turns sour. Danny Boyle's drama, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert Carlyle, Virginie Ledoyen and Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. programme.desc: S3 E2 — Lowcountry LunchKardea Brown invites a friend over to sit by the creek, share a great meal and watch the world go by. Her menu includes a Seafood Salad Roll with Charleston Shrimp and Blue Crab, Homemade Seasoned Chips and Creekside Custard Cups.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: S3 E10 — All About the SidesKardea Brown is keeping her favourite holiday, Thanksgiving, intimate with a meal for Ma and Grandma. Grandma always brings the turkey, so Kardea is taking on the sides, with Candied Yams, Oyster Stuffing and Cranberry Custard Pie for dessert.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Sausage and Mash Pie, Fish and ChipsJamie creates a sausage pie using golden mashed potato instead of pastry, and gives the nation's favourite fish and chips a healthy makeover.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Cullen Skink Fish; Spicy ChickenJamie Oliver spices up dinner with his take on peri peri chicken, makes fishcakes with sustainable white fish, and turns a simple ice cream into a cheeky treat.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S7 E5 — Jeffrey Home AloneHeading out overnight, Ina prepares a great supper and breakfast to keep Jeffrey well fed in her absence. Just as she suspects, he skips the main course, a beef stew, and goes straight for the ice cream.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

Charlie Lakin is also confident with his creation called `Tongue in Cheek'.

programme.desc: The North East chefs cook their main course and veteran Jason Atherton is looking for perfection. Will Colin McGurran's dish of duck and turnips be funnier than it sounds? programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress before the final two are chosen to face the `Great British Menu' judging panel. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E40 — Mexico v EcuadorMexico v Ecuador (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Mexico City Stadium. Mexico were one of only three nations to win all three of their group fixtures, giving them home advantage at a ground on which they have an outstanding record. Ecuador progressed as one of the third-placed qualifiers, largely thanks to their 2-1 win over Germany, which they did the hard way, coming from a goal down to finish on four points behind the Germans and Ivory Coast.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Craig and DoriStephen Mulhern hosts a look back at some of the most fearsome battles between hopeful players and the cruel Banker. programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Los AngelesJames enters the Los Angeles in style while driving a vintage Porsche. After a visit to an incredible food market in Santa Monica, he heads to the beach to cook up a storm. He also meets a pensioner who happens to be a fitness coach, drops in on old friend and chef-to-the-stars Wolfgang Puck at his Beverly Hills restaurant CUT and finishes his visit with a bite of his favourite pizza.

programme.desc: Group G Winner v Group A/E/H/I/J Third PlaceGroup G winner v Group A/E/H/I/J third-placed team (Kick-off 9.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Seattle Stadium in the USA. programme.title: Long Lost Family: False Identities Special
programme.desc: S13 E7Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two men, both of them born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. When Arthur Fitzharris's adoptive parents died he decided to find out about his birth family, and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. Bernard McGrath discovered his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S7 E1Series featuring eyewitness filming, and those behind the stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences. Footage includes a plane stalling in mid-air while skydivers are clinging to the outside, and the dramatic moment a British skier fights for her life in an avalanche. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E5 — The Outback & WhitsundaysThe duo head to the outback, where they meet a group of farmers and help them muster their cattle. The pair then make a pit stop at a local bar and take part in a pub quiz. The next day it's competition time as father and son go head-to-head in a race on lawnmowers. Their trip takes them towards the coast and the beautiful Whitsundays, where a trip on a super yacht awaits them. However, they won't be doing any relaxing, because they're working on board.

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E7 — San AntonioThe chef begins the Texan leg of his journey in San Antonio, a city which was once part of Mexico. Here, James samples traditional tamales and barbecoa at the hands of the city's most famous chef, Johnny Hernandez. The chef also tries authentic street food in the form of hot, fresh chorros, and learns about the famous San Antonio Chilli Queens.

programme.desc: S13 E7Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two men, both of them born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. programme.desc: S7 E1Series featuring eyewitness filming, and those behind the stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences. programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S16 E13 — Telford 1David Dickinson and the dealers set up shop in the International Centre in the Shropshire town of Telford. There are plenty of laughs in the saleroom as Alison Chapman sizes up some silver and Tony Geering try to do a deal with some fizz. Meanwhile, a massive collection creates big surprises when it pulls in the pounds.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E10 — JohnStephen Mulhern hosts as John gets his opportunity to open the iconic red boxes - in the game show with only one question, will John say Deal or No Deal when faced with the Banker's tempting offers or instead choose to take home what's inside his box.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E52Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S16 E90Bradley Walsh presents as Michael from Ashford, Kirsten from Birmingham, Saph from Cardiff and Terry from Hatfield pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E131 — 02/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: E10606 — 01/07/2026Cain is shocked, while the police arrive and Nicola is in a determined mood.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: E11891 — 01/07/2026Will steels himself to enter the witness box again, David voices concerns to Kit about Sarah, and Idris attempts to keep Leanne in their romantic bubble, but Toyah has other ideas.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: False Identities Special
programme.desc: S13 E7Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two men, both of them born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. When Arthur Fitzharris's adoptive parents died he decided to find out about his birth family, and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. Bernard McGrath discovered his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S7 E1Series featuring eyewitness filming, and those behind the stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences. Footage includes a plane stalling in mid-air while skydivers are clinging to the outside, and the dramatic moment a British skier fights for her life in an avalanche. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E131 — 02/07/2026A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E5 — The Outback & WhitsundaysThe duo head to the outback, where they meet a group of farmers and help them muster their cattle. The pair then make a pit stop at a local bar and take part in a pub quiz. The next day it's competition time as father and son go head-to-head in a race on lawnmowers. Their trip takes them towards the coast and the beautiful Whitsundays, where a trip on a super yacht awaits them. However, they won't be doing any relaxing, because they're working on board.

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E7 — San AntonioThe chef begins the Texan leg of his journey in San Antonio, a city which was once part of Mexico. Here, James samples traditional tamales and barbecoa at the hands of the city's most famous chef, Johnny Hernandez. The chef also tries authentic street food in the form of hot, fresh chorros, and learns about the famous San Antonio Chilli Queens.

Belgium were the pre-tournament favourites to finish top of Group G, but drew their opening two contests with Egypt and Iran, and the Egyptians sat top of the table after everyone had played twice thanks to a victory over New Zealand. With no one side from the pool standing out as serious tournament contenders so far, whoever the top team faces may feel they have a realistic chance of progressing despite their third-place group finish.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: False Identities Special
programme.desc: S13 E7Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two men, both of them born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. When Arthur Fitzharris's adoptive parents died he decided to find out about his birth family, and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. Bernard McGrath discovered his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him.

programme.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
programme.desc: S7 E1Series featuring eyewitness filming, and those behind the stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences. Footage includes a plane stalling in mid-air while skydivers are clinging to the outside, and the dramatic moment a British skier fights for her life in an avalanche. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E5 — The Outback & WhitsundaysThe duo head to the outback, where they meet a group of farmers and help them muster their cattle. programme.desc: S1 E7 — San AntonioThe chef begins the Texan leg of his journey in San Antonio, a city which was once part of Mexico. The chef also tries authentic street food in the form of hot, fresh chorros, and learns about the famous San Antonio Chilli Queens.
